dedupe_keys.name: stanford second life nmc battery ageing under grid storage cycles

description: This public OSF project provides a compressed experimental dataset on reused lithium-ion cells cycled with synthetic residential and commercial grid-storage duty cycles. Stanford Energy Control Laboratory selected six NMC INR21700-M50T cells from ten that had previously undergone about twenty-three months of electric-vehicle driving-profile tests. The second-life campaign lasted a further twenty-four months. OSF lists a single archive of about 2.15 gigabytes; DataCite rights metadata states CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a small laboratory cell set, not a battery fleet in a power network or observed utility dispatch. Prior cell history, chemistry and imposed cycles affect transfer to other second-life batteries. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating degradation or remaining-capacity components in storage simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related energy-storage modelling resource, with no direct conversion of these files verified. Neither the large archive nor its internal measurements were downloaded, and no ageing model was fitted.
